headline: Ford (F) Lands Its Biggest Army Truck Contract Since The Cold War
summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) has secured its largest U.S. military contract since the Cold War. The company will build F Series based tactical truck prototypes for the U.S. Army. The program centers on heavy duty infantry squad vehicles that adapt Ford's core truck platform for military use. For investors watching Ford Motor, this contract adds a new dimension to a story that has recently focused on valuation debates, joint ventures, and European operations.
